title: Arby's Surreal Vortex
description: A glowing orange Arby's logo floats at the center of a chaotic, swirling cosmic landscape. The scene features vibrant purple and blue nebulae, multiple spiral galaxies, a fiery orange sun, dark dripping organic structures on the left, and luminous green energy formations at the bottom.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal cosmic painting featuring a glowing orange neon Arby's logo floating at the center of a swirling vortex. The background contains vibrant purple and blue spiral galaxies, a bright orange sun, dark organic dripping structures on the left side, and glowing green energy clouds at the bottom, all rendered in a chaotic psychedelic fantasy style.
